title: Rename Phone Mirror to Phonebooth
paragraphs: "Phone Mirror" was too easy to confuse with Apple's iPhone Mirroring in Spotlight and conversation. The folder, app, CLI, bundle ID, URL scheme, env vars, support/log folders and WDA routes all move to phonebooth.
Also fixes agent.sh run exiting 1 instead of 3 on a fresh install: with no DerivedData yet, `ls | head` failed under pipefail, so the app retried forever instead of building the helper.

title: Phone Mirror: fast taps, keep-awake, and a notice when control isn't ready
paragraphs: Taps took over 3 seconds on an iPhone XS Max because WebDriverAgent's tap, touch-and-hold and W3C actions routes snapshot the app's accessibility tree around every gesture. agent.sh now compiles in wda/PMFastInputCommands.m, which adds POST /phonemirror/touch: it hands a finger path straight to XCTest's event synthesizer at screen coordinates. Taps, long presses, drags and scrolls all use it. Measured round trip is about 0.33 s per tap.

The same file adds GET /phonemirror/orientation (WDA's /orientation reports both landscapes as LANDSCAPE) and POST /phonemirror/nudge, a Shift press and release. While a phone's window is open and the phone is unlocked, Phone Mirror nudges it every 20 seconds so it doesn't auto-lock. On the XS Max with 30-second Auto-Lock it stayed unlocked through 93 idle seconds with nothing typed or opened. Phones > Keep Phones Awake turns it off.
agent.sh stamps each build with the route file's SHA, and `agent.sh run` asks for a rebuild when it changes, so editing the routes rebuilds the helper on the next launch.

Clicking, scrolling or typing before control is ready now shows a short message over the phone (unlock it, starting, setting up) instead of doing nothing. A failed command no longer restarts a helper that's still reachable, e.g. a Home press while the phone is locked.

title: Add Phone Mirror: mirror and control USB-connected iPhones and iPads
paragraphs: AppKit app that opens a window for every iPhone or iPad plugged in over USB. Video comes from the CoreMediaIO screen capture devices. Control goes through WebDriverAgent, which agent.sh fetches, re-signs for the local developer team and runs per phone: click to tap, drag to swipe, scroll to scroll, type to type.

Verified on a real iPhone XS Max: video mirroring and USB control (tap, swipe, typing including backspace, Home). Two phones at once has not been tested live yet, and the README header screenshot is still to come, so the README row and website card have no header image for now.
Wires the tool into README.md, install_mac.sh, the website tool list and AGENTS.md.
